sentences.text: To compare them, we need four functors.
Graduation and unification change the presentation.
Discretization and truncation change the dimension, between M and N.
Each of them depends on the signature and on the dimensions; from now on we leave the signature out of the notation.
So far we have two categorial extensions of the signature, two categories of algebras, and four functors between them.
We would like to obtain all four functors from a single mechanism, which works for every signature at once.
The natural candidate is a translation between signatures.
